budget.notes: DeepSeek regression profile. Credentials come from the environment only (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY for --provider deepseek); never put a key in this file or the command. --json makes Mio emit completion_call JSONL events that event_format mio-jsonl parses for real token usage. The budget block is still declared metadata; the mirrored --max-model-calls flag is what enforces the call cap. Each task uses its own temporary coordination directory; shared call/token ledgers cannot leak between tasks or into normal user sessions.
